what: On a 1px vertical line fixed at the left of the screen (110px from the top · 40px from the bottom), a 9px tick is drawn at each page heading (h1·h2) position, and a 7px square dot moves down the line by the proportion scrolled while the number above the line counts from 000 to 100 — ticks the dot has passed lengthen to 16px and darken (.16s .16,1,.3,1). If fonts or images arrive late and change the height, the ticks are re-measured.

options.heads: Heading selector to draw ticks on, default h1, h2
options.count: If off, the number above is not placed

note: The original shows this only at 1024px and wider — the consuming css hides it with display: none at narrow widths

from.where: shared.js signalLine() (.signal-line — signal line on the left of every page, re-measured at page-settled after the transition)
